title.zh: US Stocks and Crypto Plunge as Democratic Sweep Fuels AI Regulation Fears
title.en: US Stocks and Crypto Plunge as Democratic Sweep Fuels AI Regulation Fears

current_state.zh: A Democratic sweep of Congress triggered fears of tighter AI regulation and new investigations into Trump-family crypto ventures, sending US equities and crypto sharply lower — BTC -5.97% to $75,695, ETH -7.29% to $2,247, and $1.03B in crypto liquidations across 198,192 traders in 24 hours.
